sources.snippet: To enhance model performance and inference efficiency, Ling 2.0 natively integrates MTP (Gloeckle et al., 2024; DeepSeek-AI, 2024) as an auxiliary training objective. Through rigorous validation of its effectiveness and extrapolability, we found that MTP consistently improves performance on code and math tasks across different model scales.
